Even to Crawley we were still strong with Rickards, Rathbone, Thomas and Belchamber as our first four. But the heat told its tale and Rickards was the only one of them to keep going.

Allen, Askew, Belchamber, Elson and Gordon, for their generous contributions to the Prize Fund; to the R.W.A. officials and others who helped with the organisation of the race, and without whose help we could not carry on; and to the competitors themselves for their annual support.

Some months ago Jack confided to the writer that he had been inspired and encouraged throughout his long career in athletics by the thought of some of our earlier Belgrave enthusiasts - men like Parker, Belchamber and Horwood - who had impressed him in those early 1920 days with their love of the sport and their Club.
